## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Tested on desktop **and** a small viewport (or N/A)
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` behaviour considered
- [ ] No new hardcoded palette/timing values (used `tokens.css`)
- [ ] Motion follows the motion grammar (150–250 / 400–700 / 800–1500 ms)
